evidence: display message box ... title titolo icon 2

purpose.domain_detail: Warehouse/inventory management system — recalculates initial stock values (KG, UDM, monetary) from start of year to consolidation date by reversing movement causals
purpose.summary: This program recalculates initial inventory values (quantities, weights, monetary values) for a warehouse management system. It reads movement header records (TMOVMAG) and line records (RMOVMAG) from start of year to a consolidation date, applies inverse multipliers to causals, and updates progressive stock records (PROGMAG) via a called subprogram 'wprogmag'. It also handles file locking to prevent concurrent access during consolidation.

notable_features: DISPLAY MESSAGE BOX with TITLE and ICON (GUI/Micro Focus extension)
OPEN I-O ... ALLOWING READERS (file locking extension)
Pipe character (|) used as inline comments
DECLARATIVES with USE AFTER ERROR for file status handling
9 COPY statements for file definitions and linkage
verdict.notes: Source is truncated at 16000 chars; the VALORIZZA-INIZIALI paragraph is cut off. Italian-language program from what appears to be an Italian ERP/warehouse management system. The pipe character (|) comment style and ALLOWING READERS clause strongly suggest Micro Focus or a compatible dialect. No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS present. Decoded as latin-1 due to Italian accented characters.
